provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: The ylabel ' y (m) ' is set only when num==1 (L49-L51) but clf (L37) wipes it on every subsequent frame, so frames 2..99 have no ylabel; also it is applied to the transect subplot (1,2,2), the active axes at that point, though 'y (m)' semantically fits the mesh panel.
audit_member_text: Cross-line labeling defect: clf at L37 clears the figure every iteration, but ylabel is recreated only when num==1 at L49-L51, so frames 2..99 have no y label. The call also occurs after subplot(1,2,2) at L44 and labels the eta profile axis as physical 'y (m)' rather than labeling the first mesh subplot.

base_member_text: mov(num).cdata accumulates all 99 resized frames in memory (L63) although each frame is written immediately (L65); the array is never used afterwards.
Frame list starts at 1 (L12) while the sizing load uses eta_00001 (L4) — eta_00000 is skipped; whether that is intentional is not stated.
The commented export name eta_inlet_shoal_irr.jpg (L72) refers to an inlet_shoal case, suggesting this script was copied from another case's postprocessing.
dx=dy=2.0 (L7-L8) are asserted; agreement with the case grid spacing in input.txt is not verifiable from this script.

audit_member_text: All frame dimensions are fixed from eta_00001 at L4-L10, while every later eta/mask pair is loaded at L31-L32 and used at L34-L45 without checks. A changed eta shape breaks mesh/profile coordinates, and a mask shape mismatch breaks logical assignment.
The center-row expression floor(n/2) at L45 is invalid when n=1 because MATLAB indices start at 1; the file imposes no lower bound on n after size() at L6.
